project.title: Seasonal 16S rRNA and ITS1 amplicon survey of an office building ventilation system in Wroclaw Poland
project.description: This study characterizes microbial communities across airflow compartments and a surface habitat in the heating, ventilation and air-conditioning system of an office building on the campus of Wroclaw University of Science and Technology, Wroclaw, Poland. Samples represent outdoor air (ODA), primary supply air (P-SUP), supply air (SUP), indoor air (IDA), extract air (ETA), and a surface swab from the heat exchanger of a cooling and heating beam (SWAB). Two sampling campaigns were conducted on 6 March 2024 and 19 June 2024, representing winter and summer HVAC operating conditions. The dataset comprises 12 physical environmental samples, each analyzed using prokaryotic 16S rRNA gene V3-V4 and fungal ITS1 amplicon sequencing. Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina MiSeq at Genomed S.A., Warsaw, Poland. This submission contains 24 paired-end sequencing libraries and 48 original demultiplexed FASTQ.gz files from the selected study samples. These raw data support community profiling and reproducible analysis of spatial and seasonal patterns in HVAC-associated microbiomes.
